name: Verifed V29.2
description: Replaces the generic sign-in headline with the CAC-focused dietary communication message and adds a guest dietary-preference step before exploring. Guests can choose allergies, dietary restrictions and optional taste preferences, save them locally using the existing guest profile API, or dismiss the step using a plain top-left X without any border or background.
verification: Guest entry on the welcome carousel and Continue without an account from authentication now open guest dietary preferences.
Onboarding has a plain, borderless, transparent top-left X with a 48-point hit area. Closing goes to Explore without saving unsaved preferences.
Saving uses the existing api.previewProfile local persistence, with ineligible choices filtered by the existing API, then opens Explore.
The guest onboarding screen excludes the main app header and floating bottom navigation. Normal profile editing remains unchanged.
Sign-in retains its existing username/email and password submission and only changes the purpose-oriented headline and supporting description.
The mobile regression suite and Expo Snack publishing workflow must pass before release is considered verified.
